name: New School Quality American Cheese
tagline: Pasteurized Cow - New School Quality American Cheese - Santa Monica, CA
description: This cheese changes everything. As much as we all might hate to admit it, there is a time and place for good ol' American Cheese. Burgers, grilled cheese...you know what I mean. Creamy, gooey, rich...oh but the conflicting emotions that come with it when you venture to read the ingredients on the back of the Kraft package! What if you could have all of the benefit, with none of the sacrifice and conflict? There aren't many scenarios when the answer to this question is an unequivocal yes. Thanks to Chef Eric Greenspan, who has spent the better part of 25 years being a nationally recognized champion of American Comfort food, this cheese is a definite YES. Sliced from the block without cutting corners, New School American Cheese is finally American Cheese done right. Made in small batches from simple ingredients you can pronounce and recognize, like aged cheddar, cream, and real butter, there is no better-tasting or melting American cheese.

name: DeLaurenti Shredded Mozzarella and Provolone, 1#
tagline: As seen on a DeLaurenti slice!
description: As seen and enjoyed on our famous pizza on 1st & Pike! Walk in the 1st Ave door and smell the unmistakeable aroma of hot pizza coming out of the oven! So what if it's 10:45am...pizza for breakfast! Want to enjoy pizza like this in the comfort of your own home? Well, you can't do it without this cheese. It is mild but flavorful and ultra gooey! Load up and get going! Roughly 1lb of cheese amply covers a large pie.

name: Ferndale Farmstead Smoked Scamorza, 9.5oz
tagline: Pasteurized Cow - Ferndale Farmstead - Ferndale, WA
description: A signature Italian cheese...made right here in Fernadale, WA! This cheese is hung on ropes to age and lightly smoked, a technique used by artisans for hundreds of years. This gives it the characteristic pear-shaped body, which is sure to stand out on any cheese plate. A relative of Fior di Latte (fresh) mozzarella, but with a bolder and more buttery flavor. An excellent cooking cheese on dishes like lasagna and pizza.

name: Boorenkaas Farmstead Gouda
description: Boorenkaas Farmstead Gouda is a younger gouda, made by hand in small batches with the pure, unpasteurized milk from farmer’s own dairy cows. It has rich, complex flavor which compliments every dish. Try it as an appetizer, melted onto your favorite sandwich, or on a dessert plate!

name: Calabro Smoked Mozzarella
tagline: Pasteurized Cow - Calabro Cheese Co. - East Haven, CT
description: Naturally smoked for a deep aromatic flavor, this old-style mozzarella delivers the same creamy texture and excellent melt as the classic version, with an added hint of smokiness. Perfect for pizzas, panini and rustic dishes baked in wood-fired oven.

name: Danish Havarti
description: Made in the traditional Danish fashion, this Havarti is creamy, buttery and mild with a slight tang. Great for melting and grilling.

name: Emmenthaler
tagline: Pasteurized Cow - Le Superbe - Emmental, Switzerland
description: Production of this ancient cheese can be traced back to the 13th century. In its youth, it is semi-firm, mild, and nutty, becoming more aromatic and intense as it ages. Made with raw cow's milk, Emmenthaler is known for its characteristic cherry-sized holes that occur during the fermentation process. It is one of the world's greatest melting cheeses - use it in fondue, gratin or macaroni and cheese. Lastly, it is the required cheese for your pastrami sandwich.

name: Ferndale Farmstead Mozzarella
tagline: Pasteurized Cow - Ferndale Farmstead - Ferndale, WA
description:
Located just a few miles northwest of Bellingham, family-run Ferndale Farmstead combines old-world, artisan-taught cheesemaking techniques with a “seed to cheese” approach to their production. This means that not only do they source their milk from their own herd of cows, but they also grow their own feed using sustainable agricultural practices that address both the nutritional needs of the cows and the environmental needs of the land.

Delicate in flavor and texture, this mozzarella is made the old-fashioned way, with Italian cultures instead of vinegar. The result is a delightful fresh cheese that combines exceptional grass-fed Washington whole milk with traditional Italian production techniques.

name: Fontina Val d'Aosta
tagline: Raw Cow - Fromagerie Haut Val'Ayas - Piedmont, Italy
description: Often imitated, never duplicated - Fontina Val d'Aosta is the original Italian fontina. It is semi-firm & creamy, with a washed rind that imparts a mildly pungent aroma. Flavors are rich and nutty with a subtle hint of fruit and grass. One of the world's greatest melting cheeses, it is the centerpiece to Piedmont's famous fonduta - a silky blend of Fontina val D'Aosta, cream, eggs, and shaved white truffle. Also fantastic on a sandwich with prosciutto, or added to mozzarella on a pizza.

name: Gruyere 1655
tagline: Raw Cow - Fromagerie le Cret - Fribourg, Switzerland
description: Master Cheesemaker Jean-Marie Dunand runs the village dairy at 3,000 ft above sea level in the heartland of traditional Gruyère production in the Fribourg region of Switzerland. The dairy, which dates back to 1900, has been run by Dunand since 1986. He makes 18-20 wheels of Gruyère each day, 365 days a year, using freshly delivered milk from eight small local farms. After three months, the wheels are moved to the caves of Fromage Gruyère, where they are finished aging for the next 9 months before release. Each wheel is rigorously evaluated by an expert team before earning the 1655 label. The result is a cheese that is perfectly balanced. Sweet, salty, nutty, fruity, mushroomy and earthy.

name: Jack
tagline: Cow - Rumiano Cheese Co. - Crescent City, CA
description: A California original, Monterey Jack was originally made by the Franciscan monks of Monterey, California during the 1800’s and later marketed by businessman David Jacks, hence the name Monterey Jack. This staple cheese has a creamy texture & mild flavor. Great to have in the fridge for hot and cold sandwiches, tacos, nachos or for old school cheese and crackers.

name: Provolone
tagline: Pasteurized Cow - Belgioioso - Green Bay, WI
description: This is the workhorse Provolone that we commonly use on a variety of sandwiches in our cafe. As mentioned, it's great on a sandwich, hot or cold, but is also a fantastic melter for your lasagna or pizza. Mild, lactic, and creamy, it provides great flavor without being overwhelming. Looking for something more intense? Check out our Italian Provolone Piccante.

name: Provolone Piccante
description: This is real Provolone. Imported from the Lombardy region of northern Italy, it is made with raw cow's milk that has been aged 6 to 7 months. Flavors are intensely piquant, strong, nutty and fruity. Before we cut it down to size, this wheel of cheese looks like a giant head of garlic that weighs about 50 pounds. Perfect for everything from sandwiches to pizza to antipasti to lasagna.
